implementation_summary: Added a path-scoped GitHub Actions workflow that serializes braid validation per pull request and runs npm run test:braid as an independent hosted check.
consumed_inputs: Research issue #169 acceptance criteria for independent hosted validation
Existing BRAID-001 validator and 11-fixture test suite

unconsumed_inputs.reason: No external dependency was required; GitHub Actions already exists in repository infrastructure.
No visual or interaction artifact was required for this CI repair.

local.reason: Connector execution environment does not provide a checked-out repository runtime.

risks: npm ci may fail before validator execution if package-lock.json is inconsistent
Path filters require maintenance when braid dependencies change
Workflow concurrency serializes CI runs but does not replace braid task leases
rollback: Delete .github/workflows/braid-control-plane.yml and revert the two cycle-02 evidence files; preserve prior validator fixtures.
open_contradictions: The hosted workflow is isolated, but its first conclusion was still pending when this handoff was written.
The proposal branch is writable for PR repair but is not canonical on main.
acceptance_criteria: Braid Control Plane workflow reaches a terminal conclusion on the current PR head
Hosted job visibly executes npm run test:braid
All 11 fixtures and baseline validator pass
Workflow retains contents: read permissions only
PR remains draft until the isolated hosted check passes
